name: Dremo
tagline: A calm screen for the TV nobody is watching.
summary: Clocks and ambient scenes with synthesized sound for Google TV and Android TV.

highlights.label: CLOCKS
highlights.title: Four clock faces
highlights.text: Digital, flip, analog and word clock, with date and weather.

highlights.label: SCENES
highlights.title: Six live ambient scenes
highlights.text: Rain, fireplace, aurora, night sky, ocean, lava lamp.

highlights.label: SOUND
highlights.title: Sound made in code
highlights.text: Noise, rain, fire and surf, synthesized in real time.

highlights.label: SLEEP
highlights.title: Sleep timer
highlights.text: 15 to 90 minutes, a 30 second fade, then a dim clock.

highlights.label: CARE
highlights.title: Kind to the panel
highlights.text: Pixel shift every minute and night dimming.

highlights.label: PRIVATE
highlights.title: No ads, no tracking
highlights.text: No accounts, no media files. English, Spanish, Russian.

steps.title: Pick a scene
steps.text: Choose a clock or scene with the D-pad.

steps.title: Set the sound
steps.text: Each scene has a default sound.

steps.title: Set a timer
steps.text: Optional sleep timer and night dimming.

steps.title: Screensaver
steps.text: Select Dremo as the TV's screensaver.
